subject: planner: move logical join and logical selection to logicalop (#55272)
summary: Refactor moves `LogicalJoin`/`LogicalSelection` into `pkg/planner/core/operator/logicalop` and routes core-only functionality (notably join/selection physical-plan enumeration and window-topN detection) through `planner/util/utilfuncp` function pointers initialized by `pkg/planner/core/core_init.go`. Reviewed the moved logic and its call sites for join schema construction, predicate pushdown/dual replacement, outer-to-inner join conversion, functional-dependency extraction, and executor join-type plumbing; no remaining Blocker/High correctness or SQL-semantics issues found within the stated scope.
